customMethods.name: updateStep
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print('updateStep() called')

	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	procedureStepInfo = dict(self.view.custom.procedureStepInfo)
	procedureStepInfo['stepConfig'] = system.util.jsonEncode(self.view.custom.stepConfig)
	procedureStepId = procedureStepInfo['procedureStepId']
	procedureStepInfo['stepName'] = procedureStepInfo['stepName'] or None
	if procedureStepId is None: 
		procedureStepId, msg = system.kanoa.cmms.addProcedureStep(procedureStepInfo, userId)
		system.perspective.print('addProcedureStep() returned %s %s'%(procedureStepId, msg))
	else:
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.cmms.updateProcedureStep(procedureStepInfo, userId)
		system.perspective.print('updateProcedureStep() returned %s %s'%(retVal, msg))
	
	if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': "Couldn't update this step. %s"%msg})
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': "Step has been updated"})
	
	self.view.params.values.procedureStepId = procedureStepId
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.procedureStepInfo")
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.stepConfig")
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('stepUpdated', {})
	
	return

getUniqueCheckName
customMethods.script:
import re		
	data = self.view.custom.procedureStepChecks

	if baseName not in data: return baseName	    # If it doesn't exist, return immediately

	match = re.match(r"(.*?)(\d+)$", baseName)     # Extract number from "Step X"

	if match:
		prefix = match.group(1).strip() + " "
		num = int(match.group(2))
	else:         # fallback if no number
		prefix = baseName + " "
		num = 1

	while True:     # increment until unique
		num += 1
		newName = "{}{}".format(prefix, num)
		if newName not in data:
			return newName

messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print("pickListButton() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	pickListValues = self.view.custom.stepConfig.pickListInfo.pickListValues[payload['params']['txtType']][payload['params']['txtOption']]
	
	if payload['params']['txtValue'] is None and payload['text']: #This is new
		pickListValues.append(payload['text'])
	else:
		idx = pickListValues.index(payload['params']['txtValue'])
		pickListValues.pop(idx)
		if payload['text']: pickListValues.insert(idx, payload['text'])
			
	return
